attempted_claim: For the normalized Pareto alpha=3 Wigner ensemble E3 of dimension N, let v_1 be the unit top eigenvector. Then with probability tending to 1 as N->infinity, max_i|v_1(i)|^2 >= 1/2 and hence the inverse participation ratio satisfies IPR(v_1)=sum_i|v_1(i)|^4 >= 1/4, whereas for GOE, IPR=O(log N/N) with high probability; i.e. the top eigenvector is localized on the maximal entry.
